description: OLE-UPDATE pessimistic locking across processes: process A opens a server keyset pessimistic Recordset on Items and sets Txt on row 1 (EditMode), then B runs UPDATEs of row 1 and of row 3 and reads row 1 (Errors with Number, Description, SQLState, NativeError after each); A calls Update and B retries row 1; A then starts an edit of row 2 and B updates row 2; A calls CancelUpdate and B retries row 2. Asks which statements are refused, how long they wait, the error channels and when the lock is released.
